title: Otori Emu — After A Dream〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Good morning!!!
I'm looking forward to another great practice!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound as motivated as ever, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's because I am! I mean, we get to start rehearsing as a group today☆

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, a really important part of the story too. The opening scene is where the birds whisper and gossip about the phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member B
rows.Line: We need to do our best since it's going to be our job to immerse the audience into the story.

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member A
rows.Line: Oh, the way you're waddling while stretching out your neck. You're like a real duck!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apparently she's been staying in character every day wherever she goes.

rows.Speaker: Housekeeper
rows.Line: Of course. Please have a nice day.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Whoa, what you just did with your arms!
They totally looked like real wings!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: You've improved a lot since the last time we spoke.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
It's the nice lady from the Wonder Stage! And she's acting like a duck!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Whoa, you're right! Hey, can we play too?

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member A
rows.Line: I see... You spent as much time as you could in character in order to become as real a duck as possible.

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member B
rows.Line: That explains why the director was so happy with your portrayal...!

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member B
rows.Line: Yeah. He was really impressed by how you've been working despite how minor your role is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you just kept at it until today, Emu. Not many people can commit the way you have.

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member A
rows.Line: Where you lack in experience and specialized knowledge, I believe your work ethic more than makes up for that.

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member B
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling that you have a lot of other tricks up your sleeve, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? But I only have candy on me right now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We're talking about your strengths.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When you decide to practice something a certain way, you usually never stray away from it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, but you also immediately chose to observe how ducks act and behave instead of doubting your own knowledge or why you were given this role.

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, since being the Featherbrained Duck doesn't mean you can just go on stage and goof off.

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member A
rows.Line: So true. On top of that, it's hard not to sound “human” when you're trying to be funny.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, what if the director believed that you would do well as the Featherbrained Duck?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I was just trying my best since Tsukasa and Nene were also practicing really, really hard. But...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Am I really practicing my character right?
Is our show gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: Bird Cast Member B
rows.Line: Let's do our best during practice today so that our show becomes a really fun one! That includes you as well, Kamishiro!
